text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E, B, and D after gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid selling solely to lock in a profit; consider each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","I have rarely traded, and holding through small fluctuations in periods 3–5 was reasonable; I should not react to every dip or gain.","Because losses weigh heavily on me and I dislike admitting mistakes, I should set clear reasons for buying and selling in advance, and review them objectively rather than cling to a losing position."]}
